descriptionHtml:
Elevate your gaming experience with the Lenovo LOQ 15IAX9E Essential! Driven by an Intel Core i5 HX-series processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 6GB graphics, and a color-accurate 100% sRGB 144Hz display, this laptop delivers exceptional visuals, high frame rates, and smooth performance for modern gaming and creative workflows.
